json.title: Mountains Turning Pink
json.logline: A family winter drive to Gangtok culminates in the breathtaking sight of snow-capped peaks turning rose pink at sunrise.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Protagonist framed against twilight glass as soft piano note strikes
Gouache brush texture spreads across glowing mountain vista
Four-on-the-floor kick enters as frost pine detail reveals early morning light
Sunrise hits Kanchenjunga peaks, bathing snow caps in vivid pink
Warm layered memory panels shimmer with glowing mountain outlines
Drums drop out as quiet pink light settles across the landscape
Final piano chord resonates over soft sunrise horizon

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle push onto subject's profile by dusk window light
scenes.action: The young man with dark glasses gazes quietly through a window.
scenes.setting: Cozy window overlooking dark winding mountain roads.

scenes.camera_note: Parallax motion across painterly mountain ridges and valley haze
scenes.action: Deep blue-violet mountain valleys spread under early morning twilight skies.
scenes.setting: Gangtok valley viewpoint framed by misty pine ridges.

scenes.camera_note: Smooth vertical sweep following frost glints on pine needles
scenes.action: Frost crystals glisten on dark green pine needles in rising golden sun.
scenes.setting: Close foliage along a cold Himalayan mountain road.

scenes.camera_note: Forward push towards subject looking out at glowing horizon
scenes.action: The young man turns his head toward the glowing eastern sky.
scenes.setting: High mountain lookout terrace in pre-dawn atmospheric ambient light.

scenes.camera_note: Sweeping wide backward motion revealing snow peaks glowing bright pink
scenes.action: The young man stands alongside his family gazing up at glowing pink peaks.
scenes.setting: Panoramas of snow-capped Kanchenjunga peaks turning brilliant rose pink at sunrise.

scenes.camera_note: Layered gouache depth floating over morning mountain silhouette
scenes.action: The young man smiles softly in the warm glowing morning sky.
scenes.setting: Gangtok hotel balcony overlooking bright rose pink mountain ridges.

scenes.camera_note: Slow backwards dolly as mountain light settles into soft morning haze
scenes.action: The family group stands together facing the tranquil rose-tinted Himalayan range.
scenes.setting: Gangtok mountain lookout under soft pastel morning sky.
